texts.title: A Debt in the Family
texts.body: {debtor.name} owes money. Not a ruinous sum yet, but the kind that grows, to the kind of people who are patient only while it does. {debtor.first} has not asked you for anything. The steward thought you ought to know all the same.

choices.say_the_house_stands_behind_its_own: Say the house stands behind its own.

texts.title: Out of {giver.His} Own Pocket
texts.body: The treasury was short, and then it was a little less short, and nobody had been asked for anything. It turns out {giver.name} put in money of {giver.his} own, quietly, through the steward, and asked that nothing be made of it.

choices.repay_it_when_you_can: Write it down as a debt of the house.
choices.accept_it_as_owed: Accept it as no more than was owed.

texts.title: A Mean House
texts.body: {kin.Rel}, {kin.first}, has come to ask, with visible effort, whether there is anything more to be had. The house gives its own almost nothing, and {kin.he} has reached the end of it. It is being said, {kin.first} adds, that your house keeps its people shorter than houses half as rich.

texts.title: The Will Is Read
texts.body: The house is yours; nobody disputes that. But the dead head's own money, the will says, is to go in great part to {legatee.name}. It is read out in front of the family. Everyone looks at you.

texts.title: Sold Out of the Family
texts.body: It had been in the family longer than anyone could say, and now it is in a dealer's window with a price on it. The sale was yours to make. The family is taking it as though something had died.

choices.promise_to_buy_it_back: Promise to buy it back one day.

texts.title: The Loan That Sits Between You
texts.body: {kin.Rel}, {kin.first}, has owed you money for six years. Neither of you has spoken of it in four. It is there all the same, at every table the two of you sit at, and it has begun to change how {kin.he} looks at the head of the house.

choices.speak_of_it_plainly: Speak of it plainly: it is owed.

texts.title: What You Owe Your Own
texts.body: Six years ago {kin.rel}, {kin.first}, lent you money out of {kin.his} own purse, because the head of the house asked and it is not easy to refuse the head of the house. It has not been paid. {kin.first} has not asked for it. {kin.He} has begun to be absent from the table on the days the accounts are read.

choices.name_a_day: Name a day by which it will be paid.
choices.say_the_house_has_had_it: Say the house has had the good of it, and so has {kin.he}.

texts.title: One of Them Lent the Other
texts.body: {kin.name} is one of two people of the house who have settled a debt between themselves without a word to its head: the one was in trouble with creditors, the other had money put by, and it was done in an afternoon. You heard of it from the steward's clerk.

choices.make_it_good_yourself: Make the sum good from the house's money, so that neither owes the other.
choices.say_it_was_well_done: Say that it was well done.
choices.stay_out_of_it: Stay out of it. It is between them.

texts.title: The Entail Is Broken
texts.body: The court has set aside the entail, and a thing that was to go with the house for ever is now simply yours to sell. The advocates were civil about it. The family has been told, and has understood exactly what a head of a house breaks an entail for.

choices.say_why: Tell them why, with the figures.
choices.say_it_was_yours_to_do: Say that it was yours to do.
choices.promise_to_restore_it: Give your word that it will be made again.

texts.title: A Standard Comes Home
texts.body: {kin.name} won the battle and came away with the other side's standard. It is {kin.hers}: {kin.he} took it, and the fleet saw {kin.him} take it. What the head of the house says about it will be repeated.

choices.it_is_theirs: It is {kin.hers}. Let it fly from {kin.his} flagship.
choices.show_it_in_the_forum: Have it carried through the forum first.
choices.say_little_of_it: A battle won is a duty done.

texts.title: Plate for the Wedding
texts.body: {giver.name} has sent plate for the wedding: good work, with both houses' marks on it. It belongs to the one who married, not to the house. A gift like this asks for an answer, and the answer will be weighed.

choices.send_something_back: Send something back, worth a little more.
choices.take_it_as_due: Take it as no more than was due.

texts.title: Shares of Their Own
texts.body: {kin.name} has bought shares on the Exchange with their own money, in their own name. They are not the house's: what they pay goes into {kin.name}'s purse, and they give the house no say in the company. {kin.name} has told you because they would rather you heard it from them.

choices.tell_them_what_you_know: Tell them what the house knows of the Exchange.
choices.the_house_comes_first: The house comes first: buy in its name.

texts.title: A Standard Asked For
texts.body: {asker.name} has written, civilly, about the standard one of yours took from {asker.his} house. The war is over. {asker.He} would like it home, and has not said what {asker.he} would give for it. It is the holder's own, but nobody in either house doubts that the answer is yours.

choices.send_it_home: Send it home, and ask nothing.
choices.name_a_price: {asker.He} may have it for a price.
choices.it_was_fairly_taken: It was fairly taken. It stays.

texts.title: Made in {kin.His} Own Name
texts.body: {kin.name} has had something made for the house with {kin.his} own money: saved, ordered and paid for without a word to you until it was done. It bears the house's name. It is {kin.hers}.

choices.it_should_have_been_the_houses: It should have been the house's to give.

texts.title: A Gift, Unasked
texts.body: A gift has come from {giver.name}: plate, well made, with a short letter that mentions no quarrel. There has been ill feeling between you, and this is how the head of a house says {giver.he} would rather there were not. What you do with it will be known by the end of the week.

choices.take_it_as_it_is_meant: Take it as it is meant.
choices.answer_in_kind: Answer in kind, to the credit.

texts.title: Carried Off
texts.body: The world fell, and with it something of the house's own: taken from the governor's hall by the commander who stormed it, and kept. It is theirs now by the only title a war gives. The house that has it will be thought of accordingly, and so will the house that lost it.

choices.swear_to_have_it_back: It will come home, if it takes a fleet.
choices.it_can_be_bought: What is taken in a war is sold in a peace.
choices.a_thing_is_a_thing: A house is its people, not its plate.

texts.title: A Gift That Asks
texts.body: {giver.name} has sent an orrery: brass and glass, the Reach in miniature, the work of a year. There is no letter with it beyond compliments. There is also a motion of {giver.first}'s before the Senate, and nobody sends a thing like this for nothing. Keep it, and you will be expected to vote for it.

choices.keep_it_and_remember: Keep it, and remember what it is for.
choices.keep_it_and_promise_nothing: Keep it, and say plainly that it buys nothing.
